title: Qonclave edge event
description: An observation escalated from a sensing node. COMMUNICATION.md §2. Sent over HTTP (POST /api/v1/events), MQTT (qonclave/events/inbound), or CoAP, in JSON or CBOR.

hub_received_at.description: Stamped by the receiving hub, never by the sender. For a device reporting relative_time this is the only authoritative time the event has.

trigger.description: What caused the node to escalate. Values are application-defined; the framework does not interpret them. See dictionary.md for conventional ones.

confidence.description: The sending node's own confidence in its local (Tier 1) determination.

task.description: Present when this event is an escalation that expects inference at a higher tier. Absent for pure telemetry.

metadata.description: Arbitrary sensor readings and device state. A minimal-profile device with no media payload carries its whole observation here.

$comment: anyOf enforces that an event carries SOME notion of when it happened. Profiles full and constrained MUST send `timestamp`; minimal MAY send `relative_time` instead. additionalProperties is true by design: forward compatibility requires receivers to tolerate fields added in later 1.x versions.
